description: Base wallet balance: ETH and USDC balance of an address on Base mainnet at the current block, plus any one ERC-20 you name, read through the public RPC (free, no key). Source: Base mainnet RPC. Not professional, legal, insurance, engineering, medical, financial or tax advice. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402 on Base). This hosted tool does NOT pay and does NOT return the deliverable: it validates the input and returns payment instructions (pay_to, network, price and the x402 URL to pay at). GET the url; read PAYMENT-REQUIRED from the 402; retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (x402 v2). Or run the local x420-mcp server with your own wallet key to pay automatically. Deliverable once paid: JSON: block, eth{wei, ether}, usdc{atomic, amount}, token{symbol, amount}.

token.description: optional ERC-20 contract address to include (default: none)
